panels.title: Acceptance Rate
panels.description: Overall acceptance rate across the current window. Existing starter metric retained for high-level outcomes status.

panels.title: Feedback Actions (7d)
panels.description: Existing starter trend panel for feedback action volume.

panels.title: RCA Duration p95
panels.description: Existing starter panel for RCA latency tracking.

panels.title: Asset Daily Workorder Volume (30d)
panels.description: Starter panel for outcomes.asset_metrics[$asset_id].workorder_volume. Replace the placeholder target with a datasource-specific query that returns time, asset_id, and daily workorder count for the selected asset over the current 30-day range.

targets.placeholder: Map to outcomes.asset_metrics[asset_id].workorder_volume[].value or an equivalent SQL/view result shaped as time, asset_id, value.

panels.title: Asset Acceptance Rate (30d)
panels.description: Starter panel for outcomes.asset_metrics[$asset_id].acceptance_rate. Replace the placeholder target with a datasource-specific query that returns time, asset_id, and daily acceptance rate values between 0 and 1 for the selected asset.

targets.placeholder: Map to outcomes.asset_metrics[asset_id].acceptance_rate[].value or an equivalent SQL/view result shaped as time, asset_id, value.
